title: Global IT Executive Director - Digital Workplace Solutions

BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. What You'll Do To realise BCG’s digital transformation ambitions, we are evolving the Digital Workplace to deliver an intelligent, AI-enabled employee experience that improves productivity, simplifies how work gets done, and creates sustainable cost advantage. Reporting to the Executive Director, Digital Workplace Experience (DWE), this Executive Director will lead a significant portfolio within DWE, with accountability for defining strategy, accelerating transformation, and delivering measurable business outcomes across assigned products, services and enabling capabilities. Rather than acting as a functional leader for a single discipline, this role will bring together multiple complementary capabilities to create an integrated employee experience. As a member of the extended Global IT Leadership Team, you will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Operations and Enterprise Technology leaders to accelerate innovation, improve operational performance and embed AI, automation and data-driven decision making across the Digital Workplace. Portfolio Scope The Executive Director will lead a strategically significant portfolio within DWE, accountable for business outcomes across a combination of product, service and enabling capabilities. Product Portfolios Digital Collaboration: Enterprise collaboration platforms, meeting technologies, team productivity tools and GenAI capabilities that enable seamless work across global teams. Personal Productivity: End-to-end device strategy, including laptops, mobile technologies and next-generation productivity capabilities that empower individual effectiveness. Service Delivery Workplace Technology: Office connectivity, hybrid meeting room technology and the digital workplace infrastructure that powers how BCGers work across office environments. Meetings & Events: Virtual and in-person meeting experiences, together with the technology platforms that enable firm events and collaboration at scale. Key Responsibilities Provide Strategic Leadership Deliver a step change in employee productivity while continuously improving the economics of the Digital Workplace through AI, automation, platform simplification and operating model transformation. Own portfolio investment decisions and performance, balancing employee experience, productivity, resilience and cost-to-serve through data-driven prioritization and commercial decision-making. Define and execute the strategy and roadmap for assigned Digital Workplace portfolios, ensuring alignment with the broader DWE vision and enterprise priorities. Establish measurable business outcomes that improve employee experience, operational excellence, productivity and long-term value for the firm. Define and execute the AI strategy across the assigned portfolio, embedding Generative AI, intelligent agents, automation and predictive capabilities into products, services and operations to fundamentally transform how work is delivered and value is created. Build and lead a high-performing portfolio of products, services and enabling capabilities, integrating best-in-class technology, user experience, data, innovation and strategic change to deliver differentiated business outcomes. Lead the evolution of operational capabilities within the assigned portfolio, improving service quality, operational resilience and employee experience through AI-enabled service management, automation and data-driven operations. Partner with Executive Leadership, Product, Engineering and Enterprise Technology leaders to ensure Digital Workplace investments deliver measurable business value and remain aligned to the firm’s strategic priorities. Shape the future direction of the Digital Workplace by identifying emerging technology opportunities, evolving operating models and influencing enterprise investment decisions that position BCG at the forefront of digital employee experience. Provide strategic leadership in partnership with Centre of Excellence Leaders (Data & Analytics, User Experience, Change Management, and Agile Delivery). Lead Employee Experience Transformation Transform end-to-end employee journeys through the application of Generative AI, intelligent agents, advanced workplace technologies and modern service experiences. Drive the development of scalable, secure and resilient digital workplace platforms that enable rapid innovation and exceptional employee experiences. Shape technical strategy in partnership with Engineering, including Emerging Technologies, Target Architecture, Cloud First, Security, platform modernization and reduction of technical debt. Deliver innovative solutions that reduce digital friction, improve cross-functional collaboration and enhance the overall employee digital experience. Drive end-to-end digital health by improving service reliability, observability, performance and device integrity while embedding security and compliance by design across products and services. Advance Digital Product & Service Excellence Leverage data, analytics and employee insights to measure experience, identify opportunities and continuously improve product adoption and business outcomes. Embed modern product management, Agile delivery and engineering practices that accelerate value delivery and improve organizational agility. Lead strategic change, communications and adoption activities that enable successful business transformation and maximize return on technology investments. Build AI and data-driven capabilities that enable predictive insights, intelligent automation and continuous optimization across the Digital Workplace. Foster a culture of continuous improvement where employee feedback, operational data and evolving business needs drive iterative enhancement of products and services. Organizational Impact Build, lead and inspire high-performing global leadership teams across Product, Engineering, Operations teams. Develop organizational capability, succession pipelines and leadership talent to support the future evolution of DWE. Partner with MDPs and senior business leaders to shape strategic transformation initiatives and influence enterprise priorities. Establish governance, performance measures and investment disciplines that ensure transparency, accountability and measurable business outcomes. Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement across globally distributed teams. Lead organizational change that enables new ways of working, accelerates adoption and embeds a high-performance culture across DWE. What You'll Bring Who You Are Strategic leader with a track record of transforming complex tech. into business value Innovation champion with deep understanding of emerging technologies Leader who excels in global, matrix environments Change agent with proven ability to influence at executive level Collaborative leader who builds high-performing teams Curious and user-obsessed – works from the BCGer’s needs back, stays restless about raising the bar, and leads with humility and accountability 20+ years of relevant work experience; bachelor’s degree required, master’s degree strongly preferred What You’re Good At Delivering measurable business impact through technology and change management Building strong relationships with senior stakeholders Making data-driven decisions Leading through influence and inspiration Driving cross-functional collaboration Managing complex transformations Building organizational capabilities Additional info *** For US locations only *** In the US, we have a compensation transparency approach. Total compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, retirement contribution, and a market leading benefits package described below. The base salary range for this role begins at $255,000 in our lowest cost US region and goes up to $297,500 in our highest cost US region. Your recruiting contact can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. This is an estimated range, however, specific base salaries within the range depend on various factors such as experience and skill set. It is not common for new BCG employees to be hired at the high-end of the salary range. BCG regularly reviews its ranges to ensure market competitiveness. In addition to your base salary, your total compensation will include a bonus of up to 45% and a generous retirement contribution that starts at 10%. Executive Directors are also eligible for a Firm Performance Bonus. All of our plans provide best in class coverage: Zero dollar ($0) health insurance premiums for BCG employees, spouses, and children Low $10 (USD) copays for trips to the doctor, urgent care visits and prescriptions for generic drugs Dental coverage, including up to $5,000 in orthodontia benefits Vision insurance with coverage for both glasses and contact lenses annually Reimbursement for gym memberships and other fitness activities Fully vested Profit Sharing Retirement Fund contributions made annually, whether you contribute or not, plus the option for employees to make personal contributions to a 401(k) plan Paid Parental Leave and other family benefits such as elective egg freezing, surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement Generous paid time off including 12 holidays per year, an annual office closure between Christmas and New Years, and 15 vacation days per year (earned at 1.25 days per month) Paid sick time on an as needed basis Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
